## References

Fixes #19966.

## Code changes

- Skip replacing the HTML viewer blob URL when the rendered document has not changed.
- Keep an explicit refresh path so the toolbar Refresh button still forces a fresh iframe load.
- Add a Galata regression test that switches between two HTML viewer tabs and verifies the original iframe URL is preserved.

## User-facing changes

Switching away from an HTML Viewer tab and back no longer reloads an unchanged document, so scroll position and in-page state are preserved. The Refresh toolbar button continues to force a reload.

None.
